messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] error with new ggir
parts:
Hi Shashidhar,

Argument rmc.desiredtz and rmc.configtz are being deprecated and replaced by desiredtz and configtz, respectively. So, solution is to specify those instead in your GGIR call. Note that configtz is optional and not needed if timezone of sensor configuration equals timezone of sensor wear.

Best,
Vincent

Shashidhar,

I think there is currently an issue with desiredtz, where it's not being passed in to a function.

But there's actually an issue with rmc.desiredtz as well where it's not read correctly (and in GGIR 2.10.1 this problem existed in a couple more places). 

this hopefully should be fixed soon.

-Lena
